Collington Surgery is an absolute disgrace.

My elderly mother recently had to have an ambulance attend after she had breathing difficulties. They advised she contact her GP for some more prednisolone, due to her COPD and having recently had influenza,  as they couldn’t prescribe it and the only option through them was to take mum to A&E and risk her picking up another serious infection. This was sensible advice, but it didn’t end well because of Collington Surgery.

I called Collington Surgery over and over and over again yet every time I got through they just cut the call and said try later.  The next day mum was much worse so I called again and again and again and every time I got through they cut the calls the same as the day before and said try later. They just kept cutting me off - I couldn’t speak to anyone.

Due to the dereliction of duty by Collington Surgery mum ended up needing a 999 emergency ambulance out and my mum was admitted to hospital.

On one occasion previously when they actually did answer the phone and my mum was called back by a doctor in BIRMINGHAM!

On another occasion at Collington Surgery my mother was ill and I did manage to get her a face to face appointment with a GP - or so I thought - what she got was fobbed off by seeing a paramedic practitioner. He was very pleasant and said she needed blood tests and he would arrange it… My mother got home and he sent her a text message saying he was sorry but he wasn’t authorised to arrange the tests. So he clearly didn’t know what he was doing and was unaware of the protocols and procedures. The whole thing was a waste of time. Totally unprofessional.

So why has Collington Surgery declined so much when it used to be good? Well that is because it is no longer owned and run by the GP’s, it is now privatised - a business owned and run by a large corporation called Vita Healthcare PLC….

Collington Surgery is owned by Vita Healthcare, a public limited corporation whose raison d’etre is profit. It is no longer owned or run by the doctors themselves. People are customers at Collington Surgery not patients. It’s all about profit. It is part of the insidious incremental privatisation of our beloved health service. The fact is that large corporations care about one thing - profit - it’s all about the return to the shareholders - it’s business.

Vita Healthcare is closing the Sea Road Surgery at a time when we have lots of new houses being built and demand for GP services is at an all time high… This surgery is one of the oldest in Bexhill.

The final insult was discovering that Collington Surgery are ending telephone bookings and in person bookings for all appointments and that from the 2nd of February it’s all going online. This discriminates against vulnerable and elderly people who do not have internet access or cannot operate computers and smart phones.

Remember people you don’t have to stand for this from Vita Healthcare - vote with your feet and sign up with a different GP practice run and owned by the GPs. It is very easy - go to your new practice and they give you a short form to fill in, take your passport or driving licence or any form of photo ID and a bill with your name and address and that’s it - they will move you across and all your records go with you. It’s very easy. Vote with your feet!

My mother is now registered at a GP practice owned and run by the GP’s like Collington was prior to Vita Healthcare… The difference is like night and day.

I am absolutely furious with the way Collington deserted my mother when she needed them. So much so that I have written to my MP and will be making a formal complaint to NHS England.",null,[0,82]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21OaFlWaEpUMHhRYWxvelpESXdUbTh3VERjMlpuYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x91c9ca1000512703!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmNhYVhJT0xQalozZDIwTm8wTDc2Znc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21OaFlWaEpUMHhRYWxvelpESXdUbTh3VERjMlpuYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjprfuqwbSTAxUJRYQGHUsgJJcQoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjprfuqwbSTAxUJRYQGHUsgJJcQ0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUZHV1RocGVWOWZSV2hDTWs5MWVGSnZMWGhMV2xKck5GVk5ORUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpTTUVOYVFWWnFlVXhKV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tOcFVuTlFiRmxCVVhaUll6UnRObkpVVVdaalNXYxAB",["0x0:0x91c9ca1000512703",null,1767887489781942,1767887489781942,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106592999221392025672/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["SHEILA LYNCH","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJuwIMwNc5XK_mSDglZGowVPX603QVz21pCSBFXlemrs8f_WA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106592999221392025672?hl=en"],"106592999221392025672",null,2,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["2 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjprfuqwbSTAxUJRYQGHUsgJJcQ7LoGCA8oAA"]]]],null,"2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Waited on phone for 1 and  half hours to be told there are no more appointments and to ring again tomorrow at 8.30??!!
